topic: CSM Hermite-dithered cascade blend vs hard frustum-split cliff rig
topic_zh: CSM 三阶埃尔米特抖动级联阴影过渡对比朴素硬分割断崖跳变
scope: Deterministic Cascaded Shadow Map (CSM) C1 Hermite-dithered transition zone blending (W_blend(u) = (1 - s)*W0 + s*W1 with s = u^2*(3 - 2*u), W0 = 1.0, W1 = 2.0 across a 4.0 m overlap band z in [18.0 m, 22.0 m] around split plane z = 20.0 m) versus naive hard frustum split and 64-stratum stochastic dither quadrature across 17 depth stations.
